paper.title_en: Robust Strange Metallicity across Attractive and Repulsive Hubbard Models
paper.abstract_en: Using determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we compare charge transport in the two-dimensional attractive and repulsive Hubbard models at strong coupling, $|U|/t=6$. Although the interaction with opposite signs generates qualitatively different low-energy spin, charge, and pairing correlations, both exhibit approximately linear-in-temperature resistivity over a broad intermediate- and high-temperature regime. At asymptotically high temperature this common behavior follows from the moment expansion of the conductivity, whose leading contribution is even in $U$. More strikingly, the similarity persists to temperatures well below $|U|$, where strong interaction-dependent correlations have already developed, and also irrespective of whether resistivity crosses the MIR limit. Using the Nernst--Einstein relation, we find that the common linear-in-temperature resistivity is primarily associated with an approximately Curie-like charge compressibility and weakly temperature-dependent diffusivity. The two models separate only at lower temperatures, where the attractive model develops a pronounced feature in the charge diffusivity correlated with signatures of pair formation. These results show that linear-in-temperature incoherent transport in the Hubbard model can be remarkably insensitive to the microscopic nature of the low-energy correlations. Our results suggest that transport in the incoherent regime appears insensitive to what the system will ultimately become at low temperature; the distinction between competing low-energy states becomes visible only when their characteristic correlations acquire sufficiently long spatial or temporal coherence.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究Hubbard模型中奇异金属的线性电阻率，直接关联全息凝聚态物质中关于非相干输运和奇异金属行为的核心问题。采用行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法，方法严谨，理论深度较高。摘要清晰，对比吸引和排斥Hubbard模型，揭示线性电阻率对微观关联不敏感的重要结果，具有较强新颖性。虽与全息方法不同，但对理解奇异金属输运机制有重要参考价值，值得研究人员深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 吸引和排斥Hubbard模型中稳健的奇异金属性
decision.abstract_zh: 使用行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟，我们比较了强耦合下二维吸引和排斥Hubbard模型中的电荷输运，$|U|/t=6$。尽管符号相反的相互作用会产生定性不同的低能自旋、电荷和配对关联，但两者在宽泛的中温和高温区域都表现出近似线性温度依赖的电阻率。在渐近高温下，这种共同行为源自电导率的矩展开，其主导贡献是$U$的偶函数。更引人注目的是，这种相似性持续到温度远低于$|U|$时，此时依赖强相互作用的关联已经形成，并且无论电阻率是否跨越MIR极限都成立。利用Nernst-Einstein关系，我们发现共同的线性温度电阻率主要与近似居里型的电荷压缩率和弱温度依赖的扩散率相关联。两个模型仅在较低温度下分离，此时吸引模型在电荷扩散率中发展出与配对形成特征相关的显著特征。这些结果表明，Hubbard模型中的线性温度非相干输运对低能关联的微观性质可以显著不敏感。我们的结果表明，非相干区域中的输运似乎对系统在低温下最终将变成什么不敏感；竞争性低能态之间的区别只有当其特征关联获得足够长的空间或时间相干性时才可见。
